name: Leonardo da Vinci
summary: Drawings and notebook pages: anatomy, machines and flight, water and storms, horses, heads and caricatures, drapery, plants, landscapes, maps. Pen and brown ink, red chalk, metalpoint, tempera on linen, mirror-script notes.

name: Sir Isaac Newton
summary: Pages and figures from his own books and manuscripts: the Principia (1687 and the editions he oversaw), the Opticks, his notebooks and papers. Engraved geometric figures with lettered points, orbits, prisms and lenses, title pages, handwritten pages.

kinds.plate: an engraved Opticks-style plate: several numbered geometrical figures (rays, lenses, prisms) scattered on one sheet
kinds.figure: one engraved Principia-style figure on a mostly empty page: compass circles, orbits, trajectories, lettered points
kinds.notebook: a manuscript notebook page: brown ink, dense slanting hand, one small working sketch set into the text

name: Santiago Ramón y Cajal
summary: His drawings of the nervous system (Golgi-stained neurons, glia, the retina, the cerebellum, sections of the brainstem and spinal cord) in pen and India ink, and photographs he took.

kinds.cells: a few whole Golgi-black nerve cells and glia, dendrites branching to spines, axons wandering across a pale field
kinds.section: a low-power map of a whole region of a section: fibre streams as parallel lines, stippled cell groups, the tissue's own edge

name: Lewis Hine
summary: Documentary photographs: children at work in mills, mines, fields and streets for the National Child Labor Committee (1908–1924), and work portraits and the Empire State Building going up (1920s–30s). Gelatin silver prints.

kinds.height: ironworkers on skyscraper steel at height, pale sky or hazy city far below
kinds.labor: a worker absorbed in a task at a machine, window or lamp light, machine and man sharing the frame

name: El Lissitzky
summary: Works dated 1930 or earlier only (US public domain): Prouns, the 1923 Victory over the Sun figurines, posters, book and magazine design, typography, photomontage.

kinds.proun: a Proun: beams, slabs and discs in axonometric projection floating on a pale textured ground
kinds.figurine: a 1923-lithograph mechanical stage figure built from red, black and graphite-grey geometric parts on a white sheet
kinds.poster: a flat red-black-white agitprop poster: one hard division, a driving wedge or circle, scattered bars

examples: the Victory over the Sun figurines
